newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Germany's Kohl arrives in HK for fleeting visit.
newsitem.headline: Germany's Kohl arrives in HK for fleeting visit.

text.p: German Chancellor Helmut Kohl arrived in Hong Kong on Friday on the third leg of a mission to strengthen Germany's ties with Asia-Pacific nations and expand business opportunities.
He held talks with Hong Kong's future leader Tung Chee-hwa shortly after his arrival.
Tung, a former shipping magnate anointed in December, will lead Hong Kong when more than 150 years of British colonial rule ends at midnight in June 30, 1997.
British Governor, Chris Patten, is scheduled to host a luncheon for Kohl, a a government spokesman said.
Kohl, who arrived from New Zealand, will depart Hong Kong on Saturday morning.
